Union Minister Gadkari highlights media credibility crisis

Union Minister Nitin Gadkari stated that a crisis of credibility is the biggest problem facing the media sector. He made these remarks at the IIM Nagpur Media Conclave 2026, where the theme was ‘Media, Leadership and the New World Order’. Gadkari also reportedly commented on the importance of the judiciary for democracy.
